change_summary: Let the first-party CLI consume and return the same Workspace-scoped canonical document handles as Remote MCP without probing unrelated documents.

canonical_skill.note: The CLI reference uses one canonical Workspace/document handle for direct continuation and forbids list-all recovery after a route mismatch.

server_contract.note: The distribution contract names the shared canonical document-handle behavior and advances the compatible revision.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.32 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.7.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.27 accepts canonical handles across document commands, validates their Workspace locally, and returns canonical_id for reuse.

help_center.note: Localized CLI examples use the same canonical document handle returned by Corvio.

package_setup.note: OAuth, MCP endpoint and package installation steps are unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Host adapter preserves canonical_id from CLI receipts; J3T3 remains immutable failure evidence until unchanged replay.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover canonical get, bounded table-read transfer, wrong-Workspace fail-closed behavior, and Host receipt preservation.
